text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy-kun. Today is the day you, the 
sage of books, were born into this world—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, indeed! A truly joyous occasion! 
Allow this Supreme Ruler to bestow my 
personal blessing upon you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Opera O-san. Just the thought alone is 
more than enough...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, a mere sentiment will not 
suffice. After all, I am indebted to you 
for saving me when I dozed off reading and 
nearly suffocated under my own book.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, by way of returning the favor! 
I shall personally perform the heroic saga 
that Rob Roy loves so much!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, a heroic tale...!\nThank you so 
much!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well then... um. Could you recite a verse 
from "The Song of Roland"?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh. "The Song of Roland," is it? Leave it 
to me! Now... en garde!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alas, Roland was cornered by the enemy's 
fierce onslaught! And who should save him 
from his perilous plight—indeed! It was 
none other than TM Opera O!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Go, Opera O! Hang in there, Opera O! 
Occasionally Roland, but still Opera O!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? What's that!? In "The Song of 
Roland," Opera O-san...
